name: React
description: Component-based UI library with the official modern documentation.
why: The base layer for most agent-built frontends; the docs are the source of truth for hooks and rendering.

name: Next.js
description: React framework with App Router, server components, routing, and deployment conventions.
why: Common production target; agents need its caching, routing, and server/client boundaries.

name: Vercel Agent Skills
description: React best practices, composition patterns, view transitions, React Native, deployment, and writing guidelines.
why: Official Vercel engineering guidance packaged for agents.

name: Three.js
description: WebGL renderer and scene graph for 3D browser experiences.
why: The foundation for most agent-generated 3D and shader work.

name: React Three Fiber
description: React renderer for Three.js with a declarative scene API.
why: Makes 3D scenes composable with React state and component patterns.

name: Drei
description: Useful helpers and abstractions for React Three Fiber.
why: Avoids reimplementing controls, loaders, environments, and common 3D utilities.

name: GSAP
license: standard no-charge license; some plugins paid
description: Professional-grade JavaScript animation platform with timelines and ScrollTrigger.
why: Best-in-class timeline control for complex scroll and motion sequences.

name: Lenis
description: Smooth-scroll library that integrates with GSAP and native scrolling.
why: A common dependency for cinematic scroll experiences; use with reduced-motion care.

name: Rough.js
description: Create hand-drawn, sketchy graphics on canvas and SVG.
why: A distinctive visual primitive for diagrams, annotations, and whiteboard-style UI.

name: Remotion
license: company license for companies; free for individuals
description: Create videos programmatically with React.
why: The standard way to render deterministic, code-driven video.

name: HyperFrames
description: HTML-rendered video framework with skills for composition, animation, captions, charts, and rendering.
why: A modern agent-first video pipeline; the repository also ships a large skill set.

name: Astro
description: Content-focused web framework with islands and minimal client JavaScript.
why: Strong choice for marketing, docs, and content sites where performance matters.

name: Svelte
description: Compiled UI framework with reactive language primitives.
why: A high-performance alternative when the project is not React-based.

name: Vue
description: Progressive JavaScript framework with a mature ecosystem.
why: Common in existing codebases; agents should follow the project's framework rather than rewrite it.

name: Nuxt
description: Vue framework with routing, server routes, and rendering modes.
why: The Vue equivalent of a full production app framework.

name: Vite
description: Fast frontend build tool and dev server.
why: Default bundler for many modern frameworks and standalone apps.

name: TypeScript
description: Typed superset of JavaScript with a mature compiler and language service.
why: Types are the cheapest guardrail an agent can use while editing a codebase.

name: Biome
description: Fast formatter and linter for JavaScript, TypeScript, and web files.
why: One tool for formatting and linting, with agent-friendly diagnostics.

name: ESLint
description: Pluggable static analysis for JavaScript and TypeScript.
why: Still the most widely configured lint layer in existing projects.

name: Prettier
description: Opinionated code formatter with broad language support.
why: Keeps agent edits consistent with the rest of the codebase.
